title: Lazylibrarian
description: Lazylibrarian is a program to follow authors and grab metadata for all your digital reading needs. It uses a combination of Goodreads Librarything and optionally GoogleBooks as sources for author info and book info. This container is based on the DobyTang fork. For hardlinked imports, give this app and your download client the same DATA path. In LazyLibrarian, use /data/media/books as the library folder.

parameters.label: LAZYLIBRARIAN /DATA
parameters.description: Host folder mounted at /data. Use the same path for all your media apps and keep it on one filesystem, with downloads/ and media/ inside it. It must be writable by PUID/PGID.
